payload.title: File:Comparable to the Group of Polygnotos ARV extra - death of Talos - draped youths 02.jpg
payload.description_html:
object type / vase shape: attic red figure column-krater

- description side A: (female?) onlooker, Medea with (magic) box, one of the Argonauts kneeling, removing the plug from the ankle of the robot-giant Talos who falls back dying, supported by the Dioskuroi or by 2 Argonauts; a small winged figure of Thanatos helps at the killing of the giant - side B: draped youths, some with staff - production place: Athens - painter: comparable to the Group of Polygnotos - period / date: classical, ca. 450-400 BC - material: pottery (clay) - findspot: Montesarchio / ancient Caudium - museum / inventory number: Montesarchio, Museo Archeologico Nazionale del Sannio Caudino (formerly in: Benevento, Museo del Sannio) - bibliography: Beazley pottery database nr. 5362

- Please note: The above museum permits photography of its exhibits for private, educational, scientific, non-commercial purposes. If you intend to use the photo for any commercial aim, please contact the museum and ask for permission.
